title: Length-Limited Sum-K Subarrays
statement:
Use prefix sums and a frequency table to count subarrays with sum K whose length is between L and R, inclusive.

Input
Read n L R K, then n signed integers.

Output
Print the number of qualifying subarrays.

Constraints
1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n ≤ 200000. Every element has absolute value at most 10⁹. |K| ≤ 10¹⁴.
